normalization_plan.reason: The _protocol parameter only selects which protocol the deposit function operates on, so it collapses into the deposit function node.
The _dnAmounts parameter is consumed directly by depositToProtocol when transferring tokens to the protocol.
maxNAmount is a bound argument consumed inside withdraw for the burn amount check.
The account parameter is the subject of claimDistributions and carries no independent semantic weight.
The amount parameter is only meaningful inside the Address.sendValue low-level transfer logic.
nAmount is a temporary accumulator local to deposit that feeds the mint and cap logic.
yield is a temporary local whose value is passed straight into createYieldDistribution.
actualAmount is a temporary local computed and consumed within withdraw for burning.
